channel.title: Cyber Threat Wall — Latest Movers
channel.description: Actively exploited vulnerabilities rising fastest in Cyber Threat Wall rankings.

item.title: CVE-2026-19868 — SonicWall SonicOS SSLVPN
item.description: Threat Signal 64. SonicWall SonicOS SSLVPN contains a use of single-factor authentication vulnerability that may allow a user with valid credentials for an alternate authentication method to bypass SAML authentication controls. Successful exploitation may also bypass SAML-enforced multi-factor authentication (MFA).

item.title: CVE-2026-102895 — GPUStack GPUStack
item.description: Threat Signal 70. GPUStack contains an improper authentication vulnerability which could allow unauthenticated administrative access, including user and model changes, persistent administrator API-key creation, disclosure of worker and cloud-provider secrets, and code execution through POST /v2/inference-backends/from-yaml.

item.title: CVE-2026-123158 — OpenBSD OpenSSH
item.description: Threat Signal 70. OpenBSD OpenSSH on Linux contains an unexpected status code or return value vulnerability that could allow for authentication bypass.

item.title: CVE-2026-116779 — SignalWire FreeSwitch
item.description: Threat Signal 70. SignalWire FreeSwitch contains a code injection vulnerability that permits configuration and credential disclosure, arbitrary call control, and command execution.

item.title: CVE-2026-123218 — IBM Aspera Faspex
item.description: Threat Signal 70. IBM Aspera Faspex contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that could allow an authenticated user to craft a specific message to bypass authorization, causing privilege escalations.

item.title: CVE-2025-2747 — Kentico Xperience CMS
item.description: Threat Signal 79. Kentico Xperience CMS contains an authentication bypass using an alternate path or channel vulnerability that could allow an attacker to control administrative objects.

item.title: CVE-2025-57819 — Sangoma FreePBX
item.description: Threat Signal 79. Sangoma FreePBX contains an authentication bypass vulnerability due to insufficiently sanitized user-supplied data allows unauthenticated access to FreePBX Administrator leading to arbitrary database manipulation and remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2025-54309 — CrushFTP CrushFTP
item.description: Threat Signal 79. CrushFTP contains an unprotected alternate channel vulnerability. When the DMZ proxy feature is not used, mishandles AS2 validation and consequently allows remote attackers to obtain admin access via HTTPS.

item.title: CVE-2025-47812 — Wing FTP Server Wing FTP Server
item.description: Threat Signal 79. Wing FTP Server contains an improper neutralization of null byte or NUL character vulnerability that can allow injection of arbitrary Lua code into user session files. This can be used to execute arbitrary system commands with the privileges of the FTP service (root or SYSTEM by default).

item.title: CVE-2025-24016 — Wazuh Wazuh Server
item.description: Threat Signal 79. Wazuh contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that allows for remote code execution on Wazuh servers.

item.title: CVE-2025-34028 — Commvault Command Center
item.description: Threat Signal 79. Commvault Command Center contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code.

item.title: CVE-2025-30406 — Gladinet CentreStack
item.description: Threat Signal 79. Gladinet CentreStack and Triofox contains a use of hard-coded cryptographic key vulnerability in the way that the application manages keys used for ViewState integrity verification. Successful exploitation allows an attacker to forge ViewState payloads for server-side deserialization, allowing for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2024-20439 — Cisco Smart Licensing Utility
item.description: Threat Signal 79. Cisco Smart Licensing Utility contains a static credential vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated, remote attacker to log in to an affected system and gain administrative credentials.

item.title: CVE-2024-21413 — Microsoft Office Outlook
item.description: Threat Signal 79. Microsoft Outlook contains an improper input validation vulnerability that allows for remote code execution. Successful exploitation of this vulnerability would allow an attacker to bypass the Office Protected View and open in editing mode rather than protected mode.

item.title: CVE-2020-2883 — Oracle WebLogic Server
item.description: Threat Signal 79. Oracle WebLogic Server, a product within the Fusion Middleware suite, contains an unspecified vulnerability exploitable by an unauthenticated attacker with network access via IIOP or T3.

item.title: CVE-2018-14933 — NUUO NVRmini Devices
item.description: Threat Signal 79. NUUO NVRmini devices contain an OS command injection vulnerability. This vulnerability allows remote command execution via shell metacharacters in the uploaddir parameter for a writeuploaddir command.

item.title: CVE-2024-1212 — Progress Kemp LoadMaster
item.description: Threat Signal 79. Progress Kemp LoadMaster contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated, remote attacker to access the system through the LoadMaster management interface, enabling arbitrary system command execution.

item.title: CVE-2024-47575 — Fortinet FortiManager
item.description: Threat Signal 79. Fortinet FortiManager contains a missing authentication vulnerability in the fgfmd daemon that allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code or commands via specially crafted requests.

item.title: CVE-2020-14644 — Oracle WebLogic Server
item.description: Threat Signal 79. Oracle WebLogic Server, a product within the Fusion Middleware suite, contains a deserialization vulnerability. Unauthenticated attackers with network access via T3 or IIOP can exploit this vulnerability to achieve remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2024-4879 — ServiceNow Utah, Vancouver, and Washington DC Now Platform
item.description: Threat Signal 79. ServiceNow Utah, Vancouver, and Washington DC Now Platform releases contain a jelly template injection vulnerability in UI macros. An unauthenticated user could exploit this vulnerability to execute code remotely.

item.title: CVE-2024-4358 — Progress Telerik Report Server
item.description: Threat Signal 79. Progress Telerik Report Server contains an authorization bypass by spoofing vulnerability that allows an attacker to obtain unauthorized access.

item.title: CVE-2023-7028 — GitLab GitLab CE/EE
item.description: Threat Signal 79. GitLab Community and Enterprise Editions contain an improper access control vulnerability. This allows an attacker to trigger password reset emails to be sent to an unverified email address to ultimately facilitate an account takeover.

item.title: CVE-2019-7256 — Nice Linear eMerge E3-Series
item.description: Threat Signal 79. Nice Linear eMerge E3-Series contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows an attacker to conduct remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2020-3259 — Cisco Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) and Firepower Threat Defense (FTD)
item.description: Threat Signal 79. Cisco Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) and Firepower Threat Defense (FTD) contain an information disclosure vulnerability. An attacker could retrieve memory contents on an affected device, which could lead to the disclosure of confidential information due to a buffer tracking issue when the software parses invalid URLs that are requested from the web services interface. This vulnerability affects only specific AnyConnect and WebVPN configurations.

item.title: CVE-2020-2551 — Oracle Fusion Middleware
item.description: Threat Signal 79. Oracle Fusion Middleware contains an unspecified vulnerability in the WLS Core Components that allows an unauthenticated attacker with network access via IIOP to compromise the WebLogic Server.

item.title: CVE-2023-36845 — Juniper Junos OS
item.description: Threat Signal 79. Juniper Junos OS on EX Series and SRX Series contains a PHP external variable modification vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated, network-based attacker to control an important environment variable. Using a crafted request, which sets the variable PHPRC, an attacker is able to modify the PHP execution environment allowing the injection und execution of code.

item.title: CVE-2023-33246 — Apache RocketMQ
item.description: Threat Signal 79. Several components of Apache RocketMQ, including NameServer, Broker, and Controller, are exposed to the extranet and lack permission verification. An attacker can exploit this vulnerability by using the update configuration function to execute commands as the system users that RocketMQ is running as or achieve the same effect by forging the RocketMQ protocol content.

item.title: CVE-2023-24489 — Citrix Content Collaboration
item.description: Threat Signal 79. Citrix Content Collaboration contains an improper access control vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to remotely compromise customer-managed ShareFile storage zones controllers.

item.title: CVE-2017-18368 — Zyxel P660HN-T1A Routers
item.description: Threat Signal 79. Zyxel P660HN-T1A routers contain a command injection vulnerability in the Remote System Log forwarding function, which is accessible by an unauthenticated user and exploited via the remote_host parameter of the ViewLog.asp page.

item.title: CVE-2023-23397 — Microsoft Office
item.description: Threat Signal 79. Microsoft Office Outlook contains a privilege escalation vulnerability that allows for a NTLM Relay attack against another service to authenticate as the user.

item.title: CVE-2021-35587 — Oracle Fusion Middleware
item.description: Threat Signal 79. Oracle Fusion Middleware Access Manager allows an unauthenticated attacker with network access via HTTP to takeover the Access Manager product.

item.title: CVE-2022-24706 — Apache CouchDB
item.description: Threat Signal 79. Apache CouchDB contains an insecure default initialization of resource vulnerability which can allow an attacker to escalate to administrative privileges.

item.title: CVE-2022-24112 — Apache APISIX
item.description: Threat Signal 79. Apache APISIX contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2010-0840 — Oracle Java Runtime Environment (JRE)
item.description: Threat Signal 79. Unspecified vulnerability in the Java Runtime Environment (JRE) in Java SE component allows remote attackers to affect confidentiality, integrity, and availability via Unknown vectors.

item.title: CVE-2007-3010 — Alcatel OmniPCX Enterprise
item.description: Threat Signal 79. masterCGI in the Unified Maintenance Tool in Alcatel OmniPCX Enterprise Communication Server allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary commands.

item.title: CVE-2015-0313 — Adobe Flash Player
item.description: Threat Signal 79. Use-after-free vulnerability in Adobe Flash Player allows remote attackers to execute code.

item.title: CVE-2018-10561 — Dasan Gigabit Passive Optical Network (GPON) Routers
item.description: Threat Signal 79. Dasan GPON Routers contain an authentication bypass vulnerability. When combined with CVE-2018-10562, exploitation can allow an attacker to perform remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2016-0151 — Microsoft Client-Server Run-time Subsystem (CSRSS)
item.description: Threat Signal 79. The Client-Server Run-time Subsystem (CSRSS) in Microsoft mismanages process tokens, which allows local users to gain privileges via a crafted application.

item.title: CVE-2020-25223 — Sophos SG UTM
item.description: Threat Signal 79. A remote code execution vulnerability exists in the WebAdmin of Sophos SG UTM.

item.title: CVE-2019-12989 — Citrix SD-WAN and NetScaler
item.description: Threat Signal 79. Citrix SD-WAN and NetScaler SD-WAN allow SQL Injection.

item.title: CVE-2019-10068 — Kentico Xperience
item.description: Threat Signal 79. Kentico contains a failure to validate security headers. This deserialization can led to unauthenticated remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2019-1003030 — Jenkins Matrix Project Plugin
item.description: Threat Signal 79. Jenkins Matrix Project plugin contains a vulnerability which can allow users to escape the sandbox, opening opportunity to perform remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2009-1151 — phpMyAdmin phpMyAdmin
item.description: Threat Signal 79. Setup script used to generate configuration can be fooled using a crafted POST request to include arbitrary PHP code in generated configuration file.

item.title: CVE-2018-8120 — Microsoft Win32k
item.description: Threat Signal 79. A privilege escalation vulnerability exists in Windows when the Win32k component fails to properly handle objects in memory.

item.title: CVE-2013-0625 — Adobe ColdFusion
item.description: Threat Signal 79. Adobe Coldfusion contains an authentication bypass vulnerability, which could result in an unauthorized user gaining administrative access.

item.title: CVE-2015-7645 — Adobe Flash Player
item.description: Threat Signal 79. Adobe Flash Player allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via a crafted SWF file.

item.title: CVE-2013-0632 — Adobe ColdFusion
item.description: Threat Signal 79. An authentication bypass vulnerability exists in Adobe ColdFusion which could result in an unauthorized user gaining administrative access.

item.title: CVE-2011-3544 — Oracle Java SE JDK and JRE
item.description: Threat Signal 79. An access control vulnerability exists in the Applet Rhino Script Engine component of Oracle's Java Runtime Environment allows an attacker to remotely execute arbitrary code.

item.title: CVE-2022-23131 — Zabbix Frontend
item.description: Threat Signal 79. Unsafe client-side session storage leading to authentication bypass/instance takeover via Zabbix Frontend with configured SAML.

item.title: CVE-2021-40870 — Aviatrix Aviatrix Controller
item.description: Threat Signal 79. Unrestricted upload of a file with a dangerous type is possible, which allows an unauthenticated user to execute arbitrary code via directory traversal.
